```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Function to get latest RDS based on filename date
get_latest_rds <- function(dir_path, verbose = TRUE) {
  rds_files <- list.files(path = dir_path, pattern = "\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  if (length(rds_files) == 0) {
    if (verbose) cat("No .rds files found in", dir_path, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  file_dates <- sub(".*?(\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{1,2})\\.rds$", "\\1", basename(rds_files))
  file_dates <- as.Date(file_dates, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
  
  latest_file <- rds_files[which.max(file_dates)]
  
  if (verbose) cat("Loaded file from:", latest_file, "\n")
  readRDS(latest_file)
}


total_data<-get_latest_rds("data/total_data")
diff_total<-get_latest_rds("data/diff_total")
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
diff_total <- diff_total$`cumulative_applicants_Current Year` - diff_total$`cumulative_applicants_Previous Year`
```

## PM1 Progress 2025-26

```{r, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center',fig.width=16, fig.height=7, out.width="100%"}
#read in eligiblity and enrollment data



prepm1<-read.csv("data/dropbox/enrollments_20250813.csv", na.strings = c("NA", ""))
postpm1<-read.csv("data/dropbox/enrollments_20251118.csv", na.strings = c("NA", ""))
data_list<-list(prepm1, postpm1)


enrolled_students <- postpm1 %>%
    group_by(DistrictID, SchoolID, Grade) %>%
    summarise(n_enrolled = n(), .groups = "drop")

nwri_all<-readRDS("data/base_data/nwri_all_table_11172025.rds")
nwri_eligibleprepm1<-readRDS("data/base_data/nwri_eligible_table_08112025.rds")
nwri_eligiblepostpm1<-readRDS("data/base_data/nwri_eligible_table_11172025.rds")

eligiblity_list<-list(nwri_eligibleprepm1, nwri_eligiblepostpm1)

MSID<-readRDS("data/base_data/MSID_10072025.rds")


datalist_processed <- purrr::map2(data_list, eligiblity_list, function(x, y){

  # ---- CLEAN ENROLLED ----
nwri_enrolled <- x %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_squish))

# ---- LOST KIDS ----
lost_kids <- nwri_enrolled %>%
  filter(is.na(MappedDOESchool)) %>%
  mutate(DistrictName = str_to_upper(DistrictName)) %>%
  mutate(DistrictName = case_when(
    DistrictName == "MIAMI DADE" ~ "MIAMI-DADE",
    DistrictName == "FLORIDA SCHOOL FOR THE DEAF & BLIND" ~ "DEAF/BLIND",
    DistrictName == "VIRTUAL SCHOOL" ~ "FL VIRTUAL",
    DistrictName == "UF LAB SCHOOL" ~ "UF LAB SCH",
    DistrictName %in% c("IDEA", "IDEA PUBLIC SCHOOLS") ~ "IDEA PUB SCH",
    DistrictName == "FSU LAB SCHOOL" ~ "FSU LAB SCH",
    DistrictName %in% c("UCP", "KIPP", "MATER") ~ NA,
    DistrictName == "FAU LAB SCHOOL" ~ "FAU LAB SCH",
    DistrictName == "SAN JOSE CHARTER" ~ "DUVAL",
    DistrictName == "FAMU LAB SCHOOL" ~ "FAMU LAB SCH",
    TRUE ~ DistrictName
  ))

# ---- CLEAN ELIGIBLE ----
nwri_eligible <- y %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_squish)) %>%
  mutate(grade = str_remove(grade, "^0+"))

# ---- CLEAN ALL STUDENTS ----
nwri_all <- nwri_all %>%   # if nwri_all is global, this stays as-is
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_squish)) %>%
  mutate(grade = str_remove(grade, "^0+"))

# ---- COUNT DATASETS ----
enrolled_students <- nwri_enrolled %>%
  group_by(DistrictID) %>%
  summarise(n_enrolled = n(), .groups = "drop")

eligible_students <- y %>%
  filter(grade != "P") %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(n_eligible = n(), .groups = "drop")

all_students <- nwri_all %>%
  filter(grade != "P") %>%
  group_by(district) %>%
  summarise(n_total = n(), .groups = "drop")

# ---- LOST KIDS SUMMARY ----
lost_kids_data <- lost_kids %>%
  count(DistrictName) %>%
  left_join(
    MSID %>% distinct(DISTRICT, DISTRICT_NAME),
    by = c("DistrictName" = "DISTRICT_NAME")
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# ---- FINAL DF ----
df <- all_students %>%
  left_join(eligible_students,
            by = c("district")) %>%
  left_join(enrolled_students,
            by = c("district" = "DistrictID")) |>
  left_join(
    MSID %>% select(DISTRICT, SCHOOL, DISTRICT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME_LONG)%>%
      distinct(DISTRICT,DISTRICT_NAME),
    by = c("district" = "DISTRICT")
  )

  return(df)
})



part2<-lapply(datalist_processed, function(x){
  
  
  data_calcs<-x |> mutate(n_enrolled = ifelse(is.na(n_enrolled), 0, n_enrolled),
         n_eligible = ifelse(is.na(n_eligible), 0, n_eligible))  |>
  filter(!is.na(n_total)) |>
  mutate(perc_enroll = n_enrolled/n_total,
         perc_eligible = n_eligible/n_total) |>
  filter(!perc_enroll > 1) |>
  rename(DistrictID = district)
  
  
  #now make district-level tables
district_level<-data_calcs |>
   group_by(DISTRICT_NAME) |>
   summarise(total_eligible_d= sum(n_eligible),
            total_enroll_d = sum(n_enrolled),
            total_district_pop = sum(n_total)) |>
  ungroup() 
return(district_level)
})

#read in non-match data as well
nonmatchprepm1<-readRDS("data/pm1_2526/non_match_district2025-10-21.rds")
nonmatchpostpm1<-readRDS("data/pm1_2526/non_match_district2025-11-17.rds")


district_levelprePM1<-left_join(part2[[1]], nonmatchprepm1 |> select(DistrictName, n), by = c("DISTRICT_NAME"= "DistrictName")) |>
  mutate(total_eligiblity = total_eligible_d/total_district_pop, 
         total_enroll = total_enroll_d/total_eligible_d,
         nonmatch_added_enroll = (total_enroll_d + n)/total_eligible_d,
                  nonmatch_added_enroll_n = (total_enroll_d + n),

         ) %>%
   drop_na(DISTRICT_NAME) %>%
  select(-c(total_district_pop,n)) |>
    mutate(period = "prepm1")

district_levelpostPM1<-left_join(part2[[2]], nonmatchpostpm1 |> select(DistrictName, n), by = c("DISTRICT_NAME"= "DistrictName")) |>
  mutate(total_eligiblity = total_eligible_d/total_district_pop, 
         total_enroll = total_enroll_d/total_eligible_d,
         nonmatch_added_enroll = (total_enroll_d + n)/total_eligible_d,
         nonmatch_added_enroll_n = (total_enroll_d + n),
         ) %>%
   drop_na(DISTRICT_NAME) %>%
  select(-c(total_district_pop,n)) |>
  mutate(period = "postpm1")


table<-rbind(district_levelprePM1, district_levelpostPM1) |>
  pivot_wider(id_cols = DISTRICT_NAME,names_from = period,values_from = c(total_eligible_d, total_eligiblity, total_enroll_d, total_enroll,nonmatch_added_enroll)) |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(delta_eligibile_n = total_eligible_d_postpm1 - total_eligible_d_prepm1,
         delta_eligibile_perc = ((total_eligiblity_postpm1 - total_eligiblity_prepm1)),
         delta_enroll_n = (total_enroll_d_postpm1 - total_enroll_d_prepm1),
         delta_enroll_perc = ((total_enroll_postpm1 - total_enroll_prepm1)),
         delta_enroll_perc_scholastic = round((nonmatch_added_enroll_postpm1 - nonmatch_added_enroll_prepm1)*100)) |>
  select(DISTRICT_NAME, delta_eligibile_n,delta_eligibile_perc,delta_enroll_n,delta_enroll_perc,delta_enroll_perc_scholastic)



```



```{r, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE, cache=FALSE, message=FALSE}

font_size = 15
font_color = "#aaaaaa"
header_font_size = 16
header_font_color = "#97999b"
cell_padding = 6
centered = FALSE
#now create a theme for the table
slate_change<-function (font_size = 15, font_color = "#aaaaaa", header_font_size = 16, 
    header_font_color = "#97999b", cell_padding = 6, centered = FALSE, backcolor = "#272b30",
    borderColor2 = "#272b30") 
{
    if (!is.logical(centered)) {
        stop("`centered` must be TRUE or FALSE")
    }
    if (centered == TRUE) {
        centered_content = list(display = "flex", flexDirection = "column", 
            justifyContent = "center")
    }
    else {
        centered_content = NULL
    }
    reactableTheme(cellStyle = centered_content, color = font_color, 
        backgroundColor = backcolor, borderColor = borderColor2, 
        borderWidth = "1px", stripedColor = "#464a4d", highlightColor = "#464a4d", 
        cellPadding = cell_padding, tableStyle = list(fontSize = font_size), 
        headerStyle = list(borderWidth = "2px", backgroundColor = backcolor, 
            color = header_font_color, transitionDuration = "0.5s", 
            `&:hover[aria-sort]` = list(backgroundColor = "#141516", 
                color = "#ffffff"), `&[aria-sort='ascending'], &[aria-sort='descending']` = list(backgroundColor = "#141516", 
                color = "#ffffff"), fontSize = header_font_size), 
        groupHeaderStyle = list(`&:not(:empty)` = list(color = font_color, 
            fontSize = header_font_size), `&:hover` = list(fontWeight = "bold", 
            transitionDuration = "1s", transitionTimingFunction = "ease-out", 
            color = "#ffffff")), searchInputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#ffffff", 
            color = "#aaaaaa", borderColor = "#dfe3e7", `&:focus` = list(color = "#aaaaaa")), 
        inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#ffffff", color = "#aaaaaa"), 
        rowSelectedStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#181a1c", 
            color = "#ffffff"), selectStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#41464c", 
            color = "#ffffff", borderColor = "#ffffff", outlineColor = "#ffffff", 
            `&:hover` = list(backgroundColor = "#17191b", color = "#ffffff")), 
        pageButtonStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#41464c", color = "#ffffff", 
            `&:hover` = list(backgroundColor = "#17191b", color = "#ffffff")), 
        pageButtonHoverStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#17191b", 
            color = "#ffffff"), pageButtonActiveStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#17191b", 
            color = "#ffffff"), pageButtonCurrentStyle = list(backgroundColor = "#17191b", 
            color = "#ffffff"))
}
tbl <- reactable(
  # General table options
  wrap = TRUE,
  defaultPageSize = 100,
  defaultSorted = 'delta_enroll_n',
  defaultSortOrder = "desc",
  highlight = TRUE,
  table,
  theme = slate_change(centered = TRUE, header_font_size = 20, font_size = 20),
  columns = list(
    
    delta_enroll_perc = colDef(
      align = "center",
      name = "Change Enrolled PercentPoints",
      cell = data_bars(
        data = table,
        fill_color = "cyan",
        background = "#272b30",
        bar_height = 7,
        text_position = 'outside-end',
        text_color = "cyan",
        round_edges = TRUE,
        number_fmt = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)
      )
    ),
    
    delta_eligibile_perc = colDef(html = T,
      align = "center",
      name = "Eligibility Change<br>(Percent Points)",
      headerStyle = list(whiteSpace = "normal"),
      cell = data_bars(
        data = table,
        fill_color = "cyan",
        background = "#272b30",
        bar_height = 7,
        text_position = 'outside-end',
        text_color = "cyan",
        round_edges = TRUE,
        number_fmt = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 0.1)
      )

    )
  )#end of columns
  )
tbl
```
